TEMPTATION ||| Slide my fingers across the Answer's blade ||| "Watch me turn this against them all."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing the Answer from his grip ||| "I won't be a pawn in this game."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze steadily, unflinching ||| "Your presence makes me question everything I thought I knew."  
REVERSAL ||| Take the Answer firmly, shifting the power dynamic ||| "I'll decide how this plays out, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, absorbing the room’s charged tension |||
